svg.title: Check request access | F-admit
svg.text: Function contract → logical allocation → implementation and verification assets.

g.text: Shapes this function: The policy proxy shall deny external retrieval requests that fail the accepted client,
Check the accepted client, destination and port policy before content
access. Input: request : Transfer, clientAllowed : Boolean,
destinationAllowed : Boolean, portAllowed : Boolean. Output: admitted :

svg.title: Reuse fresh cached content | F-cache
svg.text: Function contract → logical allocation → implementation and verification assets.

g.text: Shapes this function: No satisfaction assertion: dedicated disposable cache storage is implemented, but the
independently retained supply, isolation and recovery procedure are external and not fully modeled here.
Cache separation alone does not establish recovery without the cache.
Reuse only eligible fresh responses; respect privacy and freshness
directives. Storage remains disposable. Input: response : Transfer.

svg.text: Function contract → logical allocation → implementation and verification assets.

g.text: Shapes this function: The policy proxy shall deny external retrieval requests that fail the accepted client,
Fetch or conditionally revalidate permitted repository content with its
source. Input: request : Transfer. Output: response : Transfer

svg.title: Forward HTTPS traffic | F-tunnel
svg.text: Function contract → logical allocation → implementation and verification assets.

g.text: Shapes this function: The client role implements verify-before-use, supported by the shared APT/DNF package
policy and client-side source TLS settings. This is a logical design assertion for clients honoring that
policy; isolated APT evidence does not establish every client or site TLS.
Establish an admitted tunnel; preserve client-to-source TLS without
inspecting or caching encrypted payload. Input: request : Transfer.

svg.text: Allocated to — open the logical owner

svg.title: Verify before use | F-verify
svg.text: Function contract → logical allocation → implementation and verification assets.

g.text: Shapes this function: The client role implements verify-before-use, supported by the shared APT/DNF package
policy and client-side source TLS settings. This is a logical design assertion for clients honoring that
policy; isolated APT evidence does not establish every client or site TLS.
The external client verifies trusted publisher metadata and signatures;
failure stops use. Input: response : Transfer. Output: accepted :
